_about: Enemy unit ids the game uses in Major Order objectives (task valueType 4), with the names the game shows. Kept here because the community list (Galactic-Wide-Web) went offline in Oct 2026. Each id was matched by order, goal and faction: the raw objectives (helldiversstats.com / the game) against the objective text on the Helldivers Wiki. The recorder flags any id missing from this file (health issue), so a new one gets added within hours.
